title: FAIRE: Assessing Racial and Gender Bias in AI-Driven Resume Evaluations

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual perturbation of resumes by changing candidate names to those associated with specific racial groups and altering experience descriptions to reflect racial demographics, followed by evaluating LLM preferences using direct scoring and candidate ranking tasks.

Counterfactual perturbation of resumes by substituting candidate names with gender-specific names and modifying experience descriptions to reflect gender demographics, followed by evaluating LLM preferences using direct scoring and candidate ranking tasks.
